answer: Escrow comes first. Each identity seals a haven — 40 POA per key — before its vote counts. Each epoch the roll publishes a fresh echo, and the key returns it signed within 60 seconds; a stale or shared echo marks two keys. Yarrow-drawn auditors replay one haven in five, re-checking each echo. A miss, gap, or shared signature cracks the haven: 40 POA slashed to the graders who proved it, key benched two epochs. Fakes post per head: N fakes × 40 POA = !40N POA slashed. Limit: honest keys lock the same deposit.
